# EventBridge Scheduler

Run one-time, rate, and cron schedules against implemented services.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#eventbridge-scheduler) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- No delivery retries; a failed run goes directly to its dead-letter queue.
- Flexible windows do not delay execution.
- ECS, SageMaker and CodeBuild templated targets are unsupported.
- KMS key ARNs are stored without customer-managed encryption.
- Role sessions are named after the schedule and the denial's error code is the target service's own (such as AccessDeniedException), where AWS reports its own scheduler codes.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
